notes.title: Patch - 0.3.416
notes.content:
[h1]Optimization & Improvements[/h1]

Hey everyone!

We have been working hard under the hood to make the game faster, smoother and ready for the future.
We rewritten some parts of the game for better adaptation to the upcoming gameplay changes. 

[h2]PERFORMANCE UPDATE[/h2]

[h3]Upgraded to Unity 6[/h3]
We moved the game to Unity 6 for better performance, stability and access to the latest features.

[h3]GPU Occlusion Culling[/h3]
Enabling this feature improved FPS for players with older gpus.

[h3]GPU Skinning[/h3]
Character animations are now handled by the GPU reducing CPU load and making things run smoother even with lots of characters on screen.

[h3]DirectX 12 Support[/h3]
Undead City now using DirectX 12 for improved multithreaded rendering. This helps the game to take advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs by splitting up graphics tasks.

These changes should give you a noticeable performance boost and prepare the game for future content and updates. 

[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]Limb Dismemberment[/h3]
Blow off limbs. Zombies now react more dynamically to where you hit them.

[h3]Wound Marks on Hit[/h3]
Weapons now leave visible damage on zombies where you hit them.

[h3]Facial Animations[/h3]
Zombies now has new facial animations.

notes.title: Changelong - 0.1.358
notes.content:
Changelog 
[h2] 0.1.358 [/h2]
[list]
[*]Improvement : The star icon on the compass is visible all time so players can navigate easier.
[*]Improvement : Loading times improvements for old hard drives.
[*]Critical Bug Fix : Leaving the game mid mission and starting another one causes the mission to bug out.
[*]Bug Fix : Disable virtual pointer on the main menu if a gamepad is not present.
[*]Bug Fix : Pressing H does not heal the player.
[*]Bug Fix : Invisible Zombies.
[*]Feature : Loot overhaul. Entire loot system has changed. Implemented Shuffle Bag algorithm more you loot more you get high tier items.
[*]Feature : Lockpicking, some vehicles have locked boxes you need a unlock them by lockpicking and get top tier loot (MP5, AKM, F1 etc).
[*]Feature :Loot pool is expanded now you can loot clips, ammo boxes, throwables and weapons.
[*]Feature : Added new weapons, MP5, Molotov, Grenade, F1, Flare gun.
[*]Feature : Interactive looting you can loot by interacting objects directly
[*]Feature : New Mission takes place in the dangerous night of undead city.
[*]Feature :Adding hit markers.
[*]Improvement: Taking damage has screen space blood fx. 
[/list]

notes.title: Delaying Release Date
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Undead City Community, [/h2]

[b]I am sorry to inform you that we are pushing release date to May 31 st. This will allow us to polish the game even further for additional 6 weeks. Thanks for your understanding. [/b]
